ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the line $a\parallel b$. Place a right-angled triangle, which includes a $30^\circ$ angle, in the position as shown in the figure. If $\angle 2 = 2\angle 1$, then what is the degree measure of $\angle 3$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution}: As shown in the diagram,\\
from the given condition we have $\angle 1+\angle 2=90^\circ$,\\
since $\angle 2=2\angle 1$,\\
thus $3\angle 1=90^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle 1=30^\circ$,\\
hence $\angle 2=2\angle 1=60^\circ$,\\
since $a\parallel b$,\\
therefore $\angle 2=\angle ABD=60^\circ$,\\
since $\angle ABD=\angle C+\angle BDC$ and $\angle C=30^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle BDC=30^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle 3=180^\circ−30^\circ=\boxed{150^\circ}$.

thus $\angle BDC=30^\circ$,
therefore $\angle 3=180^\circ-30^\circ=\boxed{150^\circ}$.
